rows.name: --pcie-frac
rows.about: The share of the missed experts the card reads over PCIe instead of the CPU computing them.

rows.name: --spec-min-p
rows.about: The draft floor: how sure a drafted token must be for the draft to go on.

rows.name: --spec
rows.about: How many tokens the draft may propose.

rows.name: --pool-workers
rows.about: The CPU threads that compute the experts not in VRAM.

rows.name: --adapt-every
rows.about: The adaptive expert tier: how often it swaps experts into VRAM, how many, how fast it forgets.

rows.name: --adapt-swaps
rows.about: The adaptive expert tier: how often it swaps experts into VRAM, how many, how fast it forgets.

rows.name: --adapt-decay
rows.about: The adaptive expert tier: how often it swaps experts into VRAM, how many, how fast it forgets.

rows.name: --kv-resident
rows.about: KV positions per layer kept in VRAM; the rest is streamed from RAM.

rows.name: --max-context
rows.about: The context the KV cache is sized for; what it does not take is left to the expert cache.

rows.name: --expert-cache
rows.about: The VRAM expert cache; auto takes what is left after the rest.

rows.name: --vram-reserve-mib
rows.about: VRAM left free for other programs; it is taken from the expert cache.

rows.name: STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE
rows.about: The CPU's share of the experts in short prompt reads.

rows.name: STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE_MAX
rows.about: The largest prompt chunk the CPU share works on (1,024 tokens by default).

rows.name: expert_profile_save
rows.about: Saves the adaptive tier's expert ranking so the next start fills the cache with it.
